verdict.rationale: A business registry could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers web-form filing through the Online Filing Centre and PDF/mail channels. The probe explicitly found no transactional API documented on any registry surface checked. The keyless CKAN API on open.canada.ca belongs to the national open-data portal, a separate platform, and is not an interactive API reference with runnable examples from Corporations Canada itself.
